SQL_DOC.P_SQL: INSERT INTO STX_MRO_SHIPMENT ( TIMESEQ , SEQ , COMPANY_CODE , SYS_CODE, HOUSE_CODE, VENDOR_CODE, DELIV_NO, DELIV_SEQ, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, PART_CLASS, PART_CD, PO_DELIV_SEQ, CURRENCY_CD, PART_NM, DELIV_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, PO_QTY, PRE_DELIV_QTY, UNIT, PO_DT, DELIV_DT, DELIV_AMT, ACC_DUE_DT, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NM, USER_ID, USER_NM, TOCOMPANY_ID, TOCOMPANY_NM, TOUSER_ID, TOUSER_NM, STATUS, LEGJOBDATE, LEGJOBFLAG, ADD_FIELD1 ) VALUES ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM STX_MRO_SHIPMENT WHERE TIMESEQ = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND COMPANY_CODE = $COMPANY_CODE$ AND SYS_CODE = $SYS_CODE$ ) , $COMPANY_CODE$ , $SYS_CODE$, '100', $VENDOR_CODE$, $DELIV_NO$, $DELIV_SEQ$, $PO_NO$, $PO_SEQ$, $PART_CLASS$, $PART_CD$, $PO_DELIV_SEQ$, $CURRENCY_CD$, $PART_NM$, $DELIV_QTY$, $UNIT_PRICE$, $PO_QTY$, $PRE_DELIV_QTY$, $UNIT$, $PO_DT$, $DELIV_DT$, $DELIV_AMT$, $ACC_DUE_DT$, $COMPANY_ID$, $COMPANY_NM$, $USER_ID$, $USER_NM$, $TOCOMPANY_ID$, $TOCOMPANY_NM$, $PURCHASER_ID$, $PURCHASER_NAME$, $STATUS$, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '100', $ADD_FIELD1$ )
